(7) One Indian boy Mirza son of Ghulam Hussein recovered by the Residency Agent and repatriated to Bombay.

(8) Two Baluchis Shambeh bin Shahim of Karawan, aged 35, and Khamis bin Ibrahim of Sadaich, aged 30, were captured by Bedouins. Shambeh fled and the Residency Agent recovered the Baluchi.

(9) The Residency Agent recovered two women and two children, Zahra daughter of Ahmed of Minab, aged 19, with a child, and Bibak daughter of Muhammed Rudbari, aged 27 and a child. The women had been kidnapped by Muhin bin Mubarak Baluchi and brought to Debai for sale.

(10) A Baluchi woman Amnah daughter of Muhammed, aged 27, took bast with the Residency Agent at Debai. Sold by her former husband Muhammed and finally sold to Muhammed bin Abdul Rahman al Qufaidi. She was given a Manumission Certificate.

(12) A certain Ghulam son of Qasim Ali Hijlasaz of Minab, aged 17, took refuge with the assistant of the Residency Agent at Dubai. The youth had been kidnapped and sold to Hassan Shah Baluchi.
